name: dsfd_gth_re-g2-COMMIT
purpose: S81 gather (dsfd_sp_gather_c, 2.9 M flops flat, does not fit its slot): hardened 4-root leaf of the gather cluster (E half: lanes enter E, leave W). Each root = ot_s81ph_ret_root_s (step B, S = 8 open rows = 2 x the measured real bound 4; S = 16 does not fit the slot: g1 stopped at FLOORPLAN_MARGIN, util 0.716): input queue in a 128 x 66 1R1W array, CAM-free pairing store {open-row slot, parent node} in a 256 x 34 array; cycle-identical to ot_s81ph_ret_root_p inside both capacities, sticky fault on a 9th open row. REAL field order (production binding d9f84be9, all 40 layers, golden experts): at most 4 (row, pos) open per root. Every port a flop at the pin; lanes passed on registered; column chain registered.

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: 22,552 flops per root (128 x 65 queue flops, 128-entry key CAM, 128 x 33 data flops, nine 128-b one-hot vectors, free list) -> two small SRAM arrays + ~2.7k flops per root; 128 roots as 32 leaves of 4 roots (two abutted array stacks per leaf, pins W / E); g2: pairing store 512 x 34 (S 16) -> 256 x 34 (S 8) after g1 failed the floor-plan margin (std 9,899 + arrays 11,369 um2 = 0.716 of the largest leaf the slot allows)
